case_name: Bhargavi W/O Hariprasad Reddy vs Hariprasad Reddy S/O Kotareddy
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife seeks to withdraw M.C.No.60/2022 pending on the file of Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Shorapur and transfer to the court of Senior Civil Judge and JMFC at Sindhanur, Raichur District.

legal_principles.principle: The convenience of the wife needs to be considered while transferring a petition.
legal_principles.held: The learned counsel would contend that the convenience of the wife takes a paramount concern while transferring the petition from one place to another.
cited_cases: N.C.V. AISHWARYA VS. A.S.SARAVANA KARTHIK SHA, (2022) SCC OnLine SC 119

legal_principles.principle: The ends of justice should demand the transfer of a petition.
legal_principles.held: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the petition.
cited_cases: N.C.V. AISHWARYA VS. A.S.SARAVANA KARTHIK SHA, (2022) SCC OnLine SC 119

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's petition is allowed. M.C.No.60/2022 pending on the file of Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Shorapur is withdrawn and transferred to the court of Senior Civil Judge and JMFC at Sindhanur, Raichur District.
